title: AutoCost Advisor: Validation, Acceptance Thresholds, and Safe Rollbacks for Batching/Caching Changes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: We are building an automated advisor that recommends batching and KV-cache configurations to reduce per-token cost. Historically, some automated changes caused subtle quality regressions (instruction-following, hallucination, or output format drift) when aggressive batching or cache-pruning was applied. Goal: implement a validation and safe-apply flow so AutoCost can propose config changes and apply them automatically when quality/latency constraints are satisfied, otherwise block and surface diagnostics for manual review.
problem_statement: Current cost-automation prototypes emit candidate configs and a rough cost delta estimate but lack: (1) a repeatable evaluation harness that ties cost changes to measurable quality signals, (2) clear acceptance thresholds for automated apply, and (3) a deterministic safe-rollback / canary policy with automated detection and remediation.
solution_overview: Deliver an integrated evaluation pipeline (AutoCost-Eval) that runs a compact but representative eval suite per candidate config. Use an anchor prompt set (golden prompts + stratified sampling from prod traces) and a mixture of automated metrics (semantic similarity, instruction-following score, structured-output validation) plus lightweight human review sampling. Define numeric acceptance thresholds and a statistical test to avoid flakiness. Implement a safe-apply strategy: staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%), timebox and metric windows, automated rollback triggers, and artifacted report generation for post-mortems.
acceptance_criteria: AutoCost-Eval runs automatically for every candidate batching/cache config and produces a deterministic JSON report
Anchored eval suite includes: 120 golden prompts (instruction, dialogue, code, long-context), 300 sampled prod prompts stratified by model and sequence length

Primary quality thresholds: semantic-similarity (embed-cosine) drop <= 0.015 relative, instruction-following pass-rate drop <= 1.0 percentage point, structured-output schema validation failure delta <= 0.5 percentage points
Latency and reliability thresholds: p95 latency change <= +15% and error-rate delta <= +0.5 percentage points during canaries
Automated canary apply flow (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with a configurable hold window (default 30 min per stage) implemented in runtime and console
Automated rollback if any primary quality or latency threshold breached during a hold window; rollback executes without human intervention and emits an incident ticket
E2E smoke tests (loadbench + warm KV cache) integrated into CI for candidate configs
Dashboard tile and daily report that surfaces candidate suggestions, accepted/rejected actions, and regression incidents
tasks: Design anchor prompt set and selection rules (Maya + Research)
Implement AutoCost-Eval runner that executes prompt set against candidate config and baseline
Add semantic-similarity and instruction-following scorers to eval pipeline
Define statistical test (bootstrap/confidence intervals) and implement significance check
Integrate eval runner with Advisor service and generate signed JSON report artifacts
Implement canary rollout orchestration in runtime with hold windows and metric hooks
Implement automated rollback hooks and incident creation in PagerDuty/Jira integration
Create console UI showing candidate diffs, key metrics, and one-click manual rollback
Add CI loadbench job to warm KV caches and validate throughput/latency for candidate configs
Write runbook and postmortem template for regression incidents
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): run AutoCost-Eval in dry-run mode for historic candidates and surface reports to SRE/Research. Phase 2 (canary): enable automatic canary apply for internal non-prod tenant with 5% traffic, require manual approval for public tenants. Phase 3 (opt-in): allow low-risk customers to opt-in for automated apply. Phase 4: fully automated for conservative profiles once observed stability > 90 days.
monitoring: Eval report store: per-candidate pass/fail and detailed metric deltas
Runtime metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, throughput per route and model
Quality alerts: semantic-similarity drop > 0.015 or instruction-following drop > 1.0pp during hold window
Rollback alerts: automated rollback executed -> create ticket + notify on #ops-channel
Drift detection: baseline drift over 7-day window -> flag advisor and pause automated applies
evaluation_suite: Golden prompts: curated set of 120 canonical prompts across verticals (support, summarization, code, multi-turn) stored in eval-repo
Prod stratified sample: nightly sample of 300 prompts covering sequence-length buckets and model variants
Unit evals for structured outputs: JSON schema validators and example-based exact-match tests
Human review pipeline: 30 sampled outputs per candidate scored by 'instruction-following' rubric (pass/fail)
Significance engine: bootstrap confidence intervals and two-sided tests to reduce false positives
